_note: UI string table. Keys are dotted identifiers (area.thing). English is the ground-truth fallback: every key used anywhere must exist here. Other languages may omit keys; missing ones fall back to this file via I18n's L() wrapper. Avoid General-Punctuation glyphs (em dash, ellipsis, arrows) - the shared ImGui atlas only covers U+0020-U+00FF, so use ASCII '...', ' - ', '>'. Accented Latin letters are fine. Keep %s/%d placeholders intact and in order.
empty.heading: No emotes in your catalog yet
empty.body:
emot3 starts empty.
Add the built-in emotes to get going:
empty.custom_hint: Or build your own under Options > Catalog.
empty.settings_hint: Tip: make emot3 yours anytime under Nexus > Addons > emot3.
newemotes.heading: New emotes available
newemotes.body: This version of emot3 adds %d built-in emote(s) you don't have yet. Add them to your catalog?
opt.gen.notify_new_bundled: Tell me about new built-in emotes
opt.gen.notify_new_bundled.on: show a prompt when an emot3 update adds built-in emotes you don't have.
opt.gen.notify_new_bundled.off: stay quiet; add new built-in emotes yourself under Options > Catalog.
opt.gen.update_available: A newer emot3 (Plus) is available (%s). The Plus build updates manually - copy the link below and grab it from the releases page.
options.ui_language.label: Interface language
options.ui_language.tooltip: Language for emot3's own interface text. Auto (default): follows the language Nexus is set to; falls back to English where a translation is missing. Or force a specific language regardless of Nexus.
options.ui_language.note: Sets emot3's interface language only. The emote commands and names are a separate setting under Options > Catalog > Built-in emotes.
view.full.desc: icon with a wrapping label below.
view.compact.desc: icon with the label overlaid on its bottom edge.
view.textonly.desc: button with the emote name, no icon.
filter.core.on: show core emotes (always unlocked, ship with the game).
filter.unlocked.on: show unlockable emotes you've marked unlocked.
filter.locked.on: show unlockable emotes you haven't unlocked yet.
filter.me_motes.on: show your /me-motes (custom chat emotes you authored).
mp.icon_scale_tooltip: Icon scale. Right-click to reset to default (1.00x).
mp.quickbar_tooltip: Open or close the Quickbar - a separate window showing one category at a time.
mp.search_tooltip: Filter activates once you've typed at least 2 characters. Matches the display name, the slash command, or an alias (case-insensitive).
mp.search_one_more: Type 1 more character to start filtering.
mp.category_help: Drag emotes within a category to reorder them. Click a category header to collapse it; drag the header to reorder categories. Right-click a header to rename or delete the category.
mp.cat_header_tooltip: Click to collapse. Drag to reorder. Right-click to rename or delete.
mp.section_header_tooltip: Click to collapse or expand this section.
mp.remove_zone: Drop here to remove from favorites
mp.no_match_filter: No emotes match the current filter.
mp.cat_no_search: (no emotes in this category match the search)
mp.cat_filtered: (every emote in this category is hidden by the current filters)
mp.core_all_fav: (all core emotes are in your favorites)
mp.unlock_all_fav: (all unlockable emotes are in your favorites)
mp.core_filtered: (core emotes are hidden by the current filters)
mp.unlock_filtered: (unlockable emotes are hidden by the current filters)
mp.core_none_flagged: (no emotes flagged as core - toggle the flag on entries in Options > Catalog)
mp.me_motes_filtered: (/me-motes are hidden by the current filters)
mp.me_motes_none: (no /me-motes in your catalog - create some under Options > /me-motes)
cells.no_drop_here: Can't drop here - drag onto a favorites category
cells.no_drop_remove: Can't drop here - right-click to remove from favorites
cells.locked_no_modifiers: Locked emotes can't be sent with modifiers.
cells.blocked_airborne: No emote plays while in the air.
cells.blocked_typing: Can't send while a text box is open.
qb.no_categories: Nothing to show here. Add a favorites category via the "+ Category" button in the Library or the addon's Nexus options, or enable a built-in category under Options > General > Quickbar categories.
qb.empty_category: No emotes in this category. Right-click any emote in the Library to add.
qb.empty_me_motes: No /me-motes yet. Create some under Options > /me-motes.
opt.mm.hlp_top: Custom free-form chat emotes that send via GW2's /me command. Set up to three variants per /me-mote (default, you, all) and pick which to fire from the cell's right-click menu. GW2 doesn't expose the current target name to addons, so it can't be auto-filled — write each variant for its context.
opt.mm.empty: No /me-motes yet. Type an id above and click Add.
opt.mm.id_min: Id must contain at least one letter, digit, or underscore.
opt.mm.id_tooltip: Stable id — favorites and the JSON file key on it. The display Name below is what shows in the Library; the id stays put so references don't break.
opt.mm.aliases_hint: Search words, space- or comma-separated (e.g. hug invite)
opt.mm.text_default_hint: Body fired on left-click (required, no leading /me)
opt.mm.text_default_empty: Default text is required — left-click sends this body.
opt.mm.restore_bundled_tooltip: Adds the bundled sample /me-motes (LFG, Ready check, Need healer, ...) that aren't already in your catalog. Idempotent — never duplicates a /me-mote you have, never overwrites one you've edited.
opt.mm.body_truncate_warn: will be cut off in chat (GW2 line limit ~199 chars; /me prefix takes 4)
opt.qb.toggle_tooltip: Open or close the Quickbar window.
opt.qb.show_cat_bar.on: tab / dropdown row above the icons.
opt.qb.show_cat_bar.off: bar hidden  -  switch categories via the wheel options below, or from the Library.
opt.qb.use_dropdown: Use dropdown instead of tab buttons
opt.qb.use_dropdown_disabled: Requires "Show category bar" to be on.
opt.qb.use_dropdown.on: single dropdown menu - saves space on narrow Quickbars.
opt.qb.hscroll.on: icons lay out column-by-column; wheel scrolls left/right. Suits a wide, short Quickbar.
opt.qb.hscroll.off: icons lay out top-to-bottom; wheel scrolls up/down.
opt.qb.snap_scroll.intro: How the wheel and scrollbar-drag snap to a grid. Off scrolls smoothly; Cells lands on whole emotes; Pages moves one full viewport at a time.
opt.qb.snap_scroll_off.desc: smooth pixel scrolling with the standard scrollbar.
opt.qb.snap_scroll_cells.desc: the wheel and scrollbar drag move one whole emote per step and land on cell boundaries, so scrolling back up always shows full rows. emot3 draws its own slim scrollbar to match.
opt.qb.snap_scroll_pages.desc: the wheel and scrollbar drag move one full viewport's worth of emotes per step (all currently-visible rows or columns), keeping the top/left edge aligned.
opt.qb.scroll_wrap.on: wheeling past the bottom row jumps back to the top, and the reverse. Only the mouse wheel wraps - dragging the scrollbar still stops at the ends.
opt.qb.scroll_wrap.off: wheeling stops at the top and bottom.
opt.qb.snap_window.on: dragging the window edge snaps to whole emote cells, so the window always frames a clean grid - no half-cut row or column.
opt.qb.allow_resize.on: drag the window edges to resize.
opt.qb.allow_move.on: drag the title bar to move the window. With the title bar hidden, drag any empty body area.
opt.qb.show_bg.off: transparent body - only icons and title bar render.
opt.qb.ct_no_drag: With the title bar hidden and "Allow move" on, click-through would leave no way to drag the window. Either show the title bar or turn off "Allow move" first.
opt.qb.ct.on: clicks on the empty body pass through to the game. Icons, title bar, resize corner, and scrollbar stay interactive. The click area is tracked one frame behind, so a very fast move-then-click may land on the wrong target.
opt.qb.ct.off: standard mouse behaviour - clicks land on the window.
opt.qb.click_through_wheel.on: while click-through, the mouse wheel over the bar scrolls/cycles it instead of zooming the game camera.
opt.qb.click_through_wheel.off: the wheel passes through to the game like clicks do.
opt.qb.click_through_wheel_disabled: Only applies in click-through mode. Turn on "Click-through empty area" first.
opt.qb.show_title.on: title bar visible; drag the title to move, X to close.
opt.qb.show_title.off: title bar hidden. With "Allow move" on, drag from any empty body area instead; close via the Library's Quickbar toggle or the Nexus shortcut.
opt.qb.high_contrast.on: category tabs / dropdown and Text-only emote buttons stay opaque. Useful when "Show background" is off and the default soft-alpha buttons get lost against the game world. Hover still brightens.
opt.qb.high_contrast.off: standard button transparency. Icon cells are unaffected - their artwork already shows clearly.
opt.qb.scroll_indicator.intro: What signals there are more emotes to scroll to. The scrollbar and the edge hints are mutually exclusive, so they never share an edge.
opt.qb.scroll_ind_off.desc: no indicator - the wheel still scrolls the content.
opt.qb.scroll_ind_hints.desc: a soft cue at a scrollable edge: a subtle shadow with the background on, a dampened accent line + glow with it off.
opt.qb.scroll_ind_bar.desc: the visible bar - a slim draggable pill while "Fit window to grid" is on, the standard bar otherwise.
opt.qb.show_tooltips.on: hovering an emote shows its command and right-click hint.
opt.qb.show_tooltips.off: no tooltip in the Quickbar (Library tooltips unaffected).
opt.qb.wheel_cycle.intro: When the mouse wheel switches categories. Scroll up for previous, down for next.
opt.qb.wheel_overbar.desc: scroll over the tab / dropdown row to change category; over the icon list the wheel scrolls as usual.
opt.qb.wheel_anywhere.desc: scroll anywhere in the Quickbar to change category.
opt.qb.wheel_cycle_wrap.on: cycling past the last category jumps to the first, and the reverse.
opt.qb.wheel_cycle_wrap.off: cycling stops at the first and last category.
opt.qb.close_esc.off: Escape ignored - the Quickbar is a HUD, not a modal.
opt.qb.combat.intro: What the Quickbar does while you're in combat. Emotes still work in combat - this only changes the Quickbar.
opt.qb.combat_off.desc: the Quickbar is unchanged in combat.
opt.qb.combat_grey.desc: the buttons dim and stop responding while you're in combat; a click explains why.
opt.qb.combat_hide.desc: the whole Quickbar disappears while you're in combat and returns when you leave it.
opt.qb.preset.help: Presets store the settings below plus the Quickbar's size and position.
opt.qb.preset.apply_tooltip: Load the selected preset - its settings and the Quickbar's size and position.
opt.qb.preset.new_tooltip: Save the current Quickbar settings and window as a new preset.
opt.qb.preset.update_tooltip: Overwrite the selected preset with the current settings and window.
opt.gen.toggle_tooltip: Open or close the emot3 Library.
opt.gen.show_shortcut: Show emot3 in the quick-access bar
opt.gen.show_shortcut.on: emot3 icon appears in the Nexus icon row at the top of the screen. Left-click toggles a window (see below); right-click opens a context menu.
opt.gen.show_shortcut.off: no icon. The window still opens via the Nexus addon menu or a keybind.
opt.gen.swap_click: Left-click opens the Quickbar instead of the Library
opt.gen.swap_disabled: Requires the quick-access icon to be shown.
opt.gen.swap_click.off: left-click toggles the Library. Right-click always opens the same context menu.
opt.gen.send_on_click.on: clicking an emote opens chat and submits the command immediately.
opt.gen.send_on_click.off: types the command into chat without pressing Enter - add free text or @ / * suffixes by hand before submitting.
opt.gen.send_me_mote_on_click.on: clicking a /me-mote opens chat, types its body, and submits immediately.
opt.gen.send_me_mote_on_click.off: types the /me line into chat without pressing Enter so you can edit before submitting (independent of the emote toggle above).
opt.gen.close_chat_on_send.on: if a chat / text box is open when you click an emote, close it (discarding what you'd typed) and send anyway.
opt.gen.close_chat_on_send.off: if a text box is open the emote is refused until you close it yourself - your typing is never disturbed.
opt.gen.chat_unbound_warn: GW2's command-chat keybind isn't set. emot3 needs it to open chat with the '/' prefix. Bind it in Options > Control Options > User Interface > Chat Command.
opt.gen.send_on_target.on: clicking a targetable emote sends it on your current target (adds @); the right-click menu then offers Send normally.
opt.gen.send_on_target.off: clicking sends without a target - use the right-click menu to send on target.
opt.gen.swallow_on_send.on: briefly holds your keyboard during the ~150ms send so held movement keys can't garble the command - you can click mid-move. Still refused while a GW2 text box is focused.
opt.gen.swallow_on_send.off: the send is refused while a printable key is held (safer).
opt.plus_badge: An emot3 (Plus) feature - included only in the Plus build.
opt.gen.precise_state.on: also blocks emotes while downed, swimming, underwater, gliding, or flying. Requires the GW2 RealTime API addon.
opt.gen.precise_state.off: only mounted state is detected (no extra addon needed).
opt.gen.rtapi_missing: RealTime API not installed - needed for swimming, gliding, downed, and similar states.
opt.gen.unusable_intro: What the Quickbar does when emotes can't be used (mounted, etc.). The options below add more triggers.
opt.gen.unusable_grey.desc: the buttons grey out in place; clicking one explains why.
opt.gen.unusable_hide.desc: the whole Quickbar disappears until the emote can be used again.
opt.gen.unusable_off.desc: the buttons stay lit; a click just does nothing (a refused send still shows its reason).
opt.gen.show_target_dot.on: a small dot in the top-right corner marks emotes you can send on a target (suffix " @").
opt.gen.show_target_dot.off: no dot - targeting still works from the right-click menu.
opt.gen.show_me_mote_indicator.on: a small accent in the top-right corner marks /me-mote cells so they're visually distinct from regular emotes.
opt.gen.show_me_mote_indicator.off: no accent - the cells still work, they just look like regular emote cells.
opt.gen.ai_fallback.on: emotes without an ArenaNet official icon show a bundled AI-generated image (when one exists for that emote). AI artwork is marked by a gold frame.
opt.gen.ai_fallback.off: emotes without an official icon show a letter fallback. Disabling only takes effect after a game restart - already-loaded AI icons stay cached until then.
opt.gen.qb_cat_favorites: Show favorites categories in the Quickbar
opt.gen.qb_cat_favorites.on: the Quickbar's category bar lists your favorites categories.
opt.gen.qb_cat_favorites.off: they're hidden from the bar - useful if you only want the built-in categories below.
opt.gen.qb_cat_core: Show Core category in the Quickbar
opt.gen.qb_cat_core.on: the Quickbar's category bar offers a built-in "Core" category holding every core emote.
opt.gen.qb_cat_me_motes.on: the Quickbar's category bar offers a built-in /me-motes category holding every /me-mote.
opt.gen.qb_cat_mad_king: Show Mad King category in the Quickbar
opt.gen.qb_cat_mad_king.on: the Quickbar's category bar offers a built-in "Mad King" category holding the emotes used in the "Your Mad King Says..." Halloween event.
opt.gen.qb_cat_unlocked: Show Unlocked category in the Quickbar
opt.gen.qb_cat_unlocked.on: the Quickbar's category bar offers a built-in "Unlocked" category holding unlockable emotes you've marked unlocked.
opt.gen.qb_cat_unlocked_all: Show Unlocked (all) category in the Quickbar
opt.gen.qb_cat_unlocked_all.on: the Quickbar's category bar offers a built-in "Unlocked (all)" category holding everything usable - core emotes plus the unlockables you've marked unlocked.
opt.unl.src_hs_tooltip: Use the Hoard & Seek addon as a proxy: it calls the API with its own key, so emot3 never sees your key. First sync shows a permission popup in Hoard & Seek. Requires Hoard & Seek to be installed.
opt.unl.src_own_tooltip: emot3 calls the GW2 API directly with a key you paste below.
opt.unl.intro:
Right-click any emote in the Library to mark it unlocked or locked.
Or use the GW2 API sync below to fill them in automatically.
The API only covers part of the emote list, so a sync only ever adds unlocks - it never removes anything.
opt.unl.autosync.on: emot3 syncs your unlocks automatically each time you start the game.
opt.unl.autosync.off: unlocks only update when you press Sync now.
opt.unl.key_help: Create a key at account.arena.net (Applications) with the 'account', 'unlocks', and 'progression' permissions, then paste it here.
opt.unl.key_storage_note: Stored in plain text in settings.json. emot3 only reads from the API - it never writes to your account.
opt.unl.status_pending: Waiting for permission. Accept emot3's request in the Hoard & Seek popup, then it will finish automatically.
opt.unl.status_done: Done: %d unlocked, %d not recognized. (API listed %d ids; %d had no catalog match - see the log.)
opt.unl.explain_body:
A sync reads which emotes your account has unlocked and marks the matches in your catalog.
Matching is best-effort: it works for built-in emotes and for custom emotes when the command matches.
The API only covers part of the emote list, so a sync only ever adds unlocks - it never removes anything. Core emotes are always unlocked. A log of what the API returned is written to the Nexus log.
opt.unl.err_nokey: Enter your GW2 API key first.
opt.unl.err_key: The API key was rejected - check it has the account, unlocks and progression permissions.
opt.unl.err_http: Couldn't reach the GW2 API. Check your connection and try again.
opt.unl.err_parse: The API response couldn't be read.
opt.unl.err_denied: Permission was denied in Hoard & Seek.
opt.unl.err_noresp: No response from Hoard & Seek. Is it installed and enabled?
send.skip.chat_unbound: Can't send - the Chat Command keybind isn't set. See Options > General.
send.skip.typing: Can't send - close the text box first.
send.skip.keys_held: Can't send while moving or holding a key.
opt.em.intro:
Your full emote catalog - what emot3 shows in the Library and Quickbar.
Add, edit, or remove any entry; hover a row's controls for what they do.
opt.em.restart_note: Replaced icons only take effect after a game restart.
opt.em.icon_header: Where each emote's icon comes from
opt.em.icon_explainer:
emot3 picks the first icon it finds, in this order:

  1. Custom path set on this row (Browse...).
  2. icons/<id>.png in your emot3 addon folder.
  3. Bundled ArenaNet official art.
  4. Bundled AI fallback (only when enabled in General > Icons).
  5. Letter fallback.

Steps 3 and 4 only work for built-in emotes. Custom emotes use steps 1, 2, or 5. Each row shows which step its icon came from.
opt.em.bundled_explainer:
Adds back any built-in emotes missing from your catalog - useful after clearing or deleting some.
Built-in emotes have a fixed id, so Restore only adds what you don't already have. Your existing emotes and edits are never overwritten.
opt.em.secondary_language_tooltip: Optional. Adds a second language's emote command words as aliases - extra terms you can search by (they also help the GW2 API unlock sync recognize emotes). It never changes an emote's name or the command it sends. Only applies to emotes added by this Restore.
opt.em.emote_language_tooltip: Language used for built-in emotes you add below.
opt.em.switch_language_note: This applies only to bundled emotes you add from here on - it doesn't change emotes already in your catalog. To switch the language of your whole catalog, clear it (below) and then Restore built-in emotes in the new language.
opt.em.restore_bundled_tooltip: Adds the built-in emotes missing from your catalog.
opt.em.clear_catalog_tooltip: Deletes every emote in your catalog and empties all favorites categories and unlock marks. Returns the window to its empty first-run state. Cannot be undone.
opt.em.clear_modal_body: This permanently removes all %d emotes, empties every favorites category, and clears all unlock marks.
opt.em.cmd_min: Command must contain at least one character after the slash.
opt.em.id_exists: An emote with Id "%s" already exists.
opt.em.id_tooltip: Id is the stable key (favorites, unlocks, icon). Read-only - delete and re-add to change it.
opt.em.cmd_field_tooltip: The slash command sent to chat when you click this emote. Edit it to whatever wording you like - emotes have several command variants and they work regardless of your game's language. Need not be unique.
opt.em.shared_command_tooltip: Another emote sends the same command. Harmless, just redundant - both open chat with this text.
opt.em.name_dup: Name "%s" is already used by another emote.
opt.em.targetable_tooltip: Lets you suffix this emote with " @" to target it on a creature.
opt.em.core.on: emote is always unlocked (ships with the game).
opt.em.core.off: unlock state is manual - right-click in the Library to toggle.
opt.em.mad_king_tooltip: Part of the "Your Mad King Says..." Halloween event emote set. Drives the optional Mad King category in the Quickbar.
opt.em.aliases_tooltip: Alternate slash commands that also trigger this emote, separated by spaces. Used to recognize the emote during GW2 API unlock sync and in search. Not used when sending - that always uses the Command above.
opt.em.browse_tooltip: Pick a PNG. Files inside addons/emot3/icons are stored as a relative path.
opt.em.clear_icon_tooltip: Clear custom path. Status drops back to the next available source (folder override, bundle, fallback).
shortcut.update_copy_tooltip: Copies the download link to your clipboard.
shortcut.settings_tooltip: Open Nexus > Addons > emot3 for the full Options panel.
